rules: A newer integration layer must never be overwritten by an older installer.
Before semantic merge, compute dependency impact and create a CAS snapshot.
CPU path remains mandatory; GPU can only be an optional accelerator.
100% claims require evidence from the relevant gate, not static constants.
New technology requires consensus: compatibility + CPU/cost + policy/security + sandbox + regression + canary.
A CERTIFIED_100 function is protected by a monotonic baseline; any regression blocks release.
New functions are SHADOW-first and may add capabilities but may not remove certified capabilities.
Replacing a certified function requires dual-run equivalence evidence, retained fallback and canary promotion.
100% certification expires whenever required evidence fails, becomes stale, or the function dependency/source changes without fresh recertification.
